correctness.rationale: The identities for * and dot+* were independently enumerated over F2 and F3 over all q^8 bilinear products, matching r=c, s=-b, g=-c, d=-b and b(a+b+c-h)=c(a+b+c-h)=0. These equations are characteristic-free and imply H∪P with sizes q³,q²,q; for K×K the only first-product automorphisms permute two primitive idempotents, giving the involution (a,b,c,h)↦(h,-c,-b,a) with fixed locus a=h,c=-b of size q². Burnside yields q(q²+2q-1)/2 classes and q² singleton orbits, q(q²-1)/2 doublets. The field nature (zero-product) is crucial; q2 signs collapse but fixed equations remain valid. F2 produced 10 valid products and F3 33, exactly the formulas; finite checks do not establish arbitrary field by themselves.
